import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long INF = 1000000007L;
    static int K;
    static List<Long> num = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<List<long[]>> trans;
    static List<List<List<long[]>>> base = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<List<List<long[]>>> pref = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<List<List<long[]>>> suf = new ArrayList<>();
    static long result;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long N = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextInt();

        while (N != 0) {
            num.add(N % K);
            N /= K;
        }

        int maxSize = K + 1;

        // Initialize base, pref, suf
        for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
            base.add(new ArrayList<>());
            pref.add(new ArrayList<>());
            suf.add(new ArrayList<>());
            for (int j = 0; j < 30; j++) {
                base.get(i).add(new ArrayList<>());
                pref.get(i).add(new ArrayList<>());
                suf.get(i).add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        // Initialize trans matrix
        trans = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            List<long[]> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                long[] arr = new long[maxSize];
                if (i == j) {
                    arr[j] = 1;
                }
                row.add(arr);
            }
            trans.add(row);
        }

        // Build base matrices
        for (int i = 0; i < num.size(); i++) {
            int idx = i;
            // Initialize base[i][0]
            List<long[]> base_i_0 = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                long[] arr = new long[maxSize];
                arr[j] = 1;
                base_i_0.add(arr);
            }
            base.get(idx).set(0, base_i_0);

            // Compute pref and suf
            if (i > 0) {
                // pref[i-1][0]
                pref.get(i - 1).set(0, deepCopyMatrix(base.get(i - 1).get(0)));
                for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                    pref.get(i - 1).set(j, multiply(pref.get(i - 1).get(j - 1), base.get(i - 1).get(j)));
                }

                // suf[i-1][K-1]
                suf.get(i - 1).set(K - 1, deepCopyMatrix(base.get(i - 1).get(K - 1)));
                for (int j = K - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                    suf.get(i - 1).set(j, multiply(base.get(i - 1).get(j), suf.get(i - 1).get(j + 1)));
                }

                // base[i][0]
                base.get(idx).set(0, deepCopyMatrix(pref.get(i - 1).get(K - 1)));

                // base[i][j]
                for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                    base.get(idx).set(j, multiply(suf.get(i - 1).get(j), pref.get(i - 1).get(j - 1)));
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize trans matrix to identity
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= K; k++) {
                    trans.get(i).get(j)[k] = 0;
                }
            }
            trans.get(i).get(i)[i] = 1;
        }

        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = num.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int x = num.get(i).intValue();
            for (int j = 0; j < x; j++) {
                trans = multiply(trans, base.get(i).get(sum));
                sum++;
                if (sum >= K) sum -= K;
            }
        }

        result = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            result += trans.get(K).get(i)[i];
            result %= INF;
        }

        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }

    static List<long[]> deepCopyMatrix(List<long[]> matrix) {
        List<long[]> copy = new ArrayList<>();
        for (long[] row : matrix) {
            long[] newRow = new long[row.length];
            System.arraycopy(row, 0, newRow, 0, row.length);
            copy.add(newRow);
        }
        return copy;
    }

    static List<List<long[]>> multiply(List<List<long[]>> a, List<List<long[]>> b) {
        int size = a.size();
        List<List<long[]>> res = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            res.add(new ArrayList<>());
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                long[] arr = new long[a.get(0).get(0).length];
                res.get(i).add(arr);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < size; k++) {
                    long[] aRow = a.get(i).get(k);
                    long[] bCol = b.get(k).get(j);
                    for (int l = 0; l < aRow.length; l++) {
                        res.get(i).get(j)[l] += aRow[l] * bCol[l];
                        res.get(i).get(j)[l] %= INF;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static List<long[]> multiply(List<long[]> a, List<long[]> b) {
        int size = a.size();
        long[] res = new long[a.get(0).length];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                for (int l = 0; l < a.get(i).length; l++) {
                    res[l] += a[i][l] * b[j][l];
                    res[l] %= INF;
                }
            }
        }
        List<long[]> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            long[] arr = new long[a.get(0).length];
            System.arraycopy(res, 0, arr, 0, arr.length);
            result.add(arr);
        }
        return result;
    }
}
